text:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained p99 latency > 1.0s in eu-west-1 on prod-cluster-7 pool 2xH100. Trigger=latency_slo_violation. Incident=INC-2026-0612

maria (oncall): paging runtime and infra. We're seeing long tails and backlog on the 2xH100 pool. p95 ~ 320ms but p99 ~1.1-1.6s. A spike started after an external customer campaign.

sandeep (runtime): pulling continuous-batching metrics. Autoscaler bumped batching.window_ms to 50ms and avg_batch_size jumped to ~150 on some nodes. That plus larger model token budgets equals long tail.

ops-bot: cluster snapshot:
```
cluster: prod-cluster-7
pool: 2xH100
req_rate: 410r/s (baseline 350r/s)
avg_batch_size: 64 -> 150
batch.window_ms: auto (~50ms)
batch.max_tokens_per_batch: 16384
p99_latency: 1.32s
queue_length: 26
kvcache.hit_ratio: 0.77
```

sandeep (runtime): mitigation options: 1) emergency cap batch.window_ms to a low fixed value 2) reduce max_tokens_per_batch 3) pause autoscaler to avoid further overshoot 4) tenant-level shaping. Prefer gradual: canary low window + pause autoscale temporarily.

leo (infra): pausing autoscaler safer than full rollback; avoids thrash. We can flip autoscaler.enabled=false on a few nodes. Note: pausing may prevent subsequent scale-up when load drops.

maria (oncall): customer-impact? any known customers in eu-west-1 on long-context gen? Jess?

jess (customer-success): two medium customers, one enterprise. Growth customer may hit rate caps. I'll draft an advisory if we enact caps.

sandeep (runtime): proposed Plan: Canary set on 8% nodes -> batch.window_ms=10ms, batch.max_tokens_per_batch=8192, pause autoscaler on canary nodes. Then observe 2-3m. If p99 improves, expand to 50% and apply tenant shaping: free=30r/s, growth=80r/s, enterprise=prioritized. Also enable kernel-reuse heuristic to offset CPU.

maria (oncall): run the canary. Kai, you'll pick up the handoff if things look stable.

sandeep (runtime): issuing canary commands:
```
# canary patch ~8% nodes
redwoodctl rollout patch --cluster prod-cluster-7 --pool 2xH100 \
  --selector canary=true --set inference.batching.window_ms=10 \
  --set inference.batching.max_tokens_per_batch=8192 \
  --set autoscaler.enabled=false
```

sandeep (runtime): canary applied to nodes node-701,node-702,node-704. Waiting for telemetry window 90s.

ops-bot: Canary metrics (90s): canary p99=0.62s (was 1.32s), avg_batch_size on canary nodes=48, request_rate unchanged. No error spike.

maria (oncall): strong signal. Expand to 50% and add tenant shaping. Prepare rollback cmd too.

sandeep (runtime): applying expansion and traffic-shaper config:
```
redwoodctl rollout patch --cluster prod-cluster-7 --pool 2xH100 \
  --set inference.batching.window_ms=10 --set inference.batching.max_tokens_per_batch=8192 \
  --wave-interval=180s --wave-size=20%

redwoodctl config apply --service traffic-shaper <<EOF
- match: tenant_plan: free
  action: limit
  rate: 30req/s
- match: tenant_plan: growth
  action: limit
  rate: 80req/s
- match: tenant_plan: enterprise
  action: prioritize
EOF
```

ops-bot: Expansion snapshot: 50% nodes updated. Global p99 dropped to 0.68s, queue_length down to 7, error_rate 0.018%.

jess (customer-success): notified growth customer and enterprise contacts. One growth tenant asked for ETA on throughput restoration; I told them we'll post a follow-up after autoscaler tuning.

maria (oncall): CPU increased modestly as smaller batches cause more kernel invocations. Sandeep any low-latency CPU relief?

sandeep (runtime): enabling kernel-reuse and small-kernel bundling for non-enterprise tenants to reduce kernel-launch overhead. Also enable token-quant-hint for best-effort tenants.

# toggles
redwoodctl feature toggle --feature kernel_reuse --enable --selector pool=2xH100
redwoodctl feature toggle --feature small_kernel_bundling --enable --selector tenant_plan!=enterprise
redwoodctl feature toggle --feature token_quant_hint --enable --selector tenant_plan!=enterprise

sandeep (runtime): toggles applied. CPU down ~7% on updated nodes, p99 stable ~0.66s.

maria (oncall): monitoring 20m. If steady, complete rollout. Also file follow-up for autoscaler hysteresis and per-tenant batch caps. Leo please add a safe_cap to autoscaler to keep window_ms <= 35ms under spike.

leo (infra): creating INFRA-2201: "autoscaler safe cap + per-tenant autoscale guards". Will add parameter safe_max_window_ms default=35ms and spike_detector to avoid rapid upscales.

ops-bot: 20m check: p99=0.69s, request_rate normalized, error_rate=0.014%. No 502/504 spike.

maria (oncall): proceed to full rollout with 4-min waves. Sandeep kick off final rollout and set post-rollout watch.

sandeep (runtime): issuing final rollout:
```
redwoodctl rollout patch --cluster prod-cluster-7 --pool 2xH100 \
  --set inference.batching.window_ms=10 --set inference.batching.max_tokens_per_batch=8192 \
  --wave-interval=240s
```

ops-bot: Full rollout started: 10% -> 30% -> 50% -> 70% -> 100% (4min waves). Monitoring dashboards live.

maria (oncall): handoff notes for kai (night):
- mitigation applied: inference.batching.window_ms=10ms, max_tokens_per_batch=8192 for pool 2xH100 in prod-cluster-7
- autoscaler paused on updated nodes; global autoscaler safe_cap to be added by infra follow-up
- traffic shaping: free=30r/s, growth=80r/s, enterprise prioritized
- feature toggles enabled: kernel_reuse, small_kernel_bundling, token_quant_hint for non-enterprise
- alerts to watch: latency.p99.eu-west-1, queue_length_pool_2xH100, cpu_utilization_pool_2xH100, autoscaler.activity
- rollback cmds:
```
# rollback to auto batching and re-enable autoscaler
redwoodctl config patch --cluster prod-cluster-7 --pool 2xH100 \
  --set inference.batching.window_ms=auto --set inference.batching.max_tokens_per_batch=16384 \
  --set autoscaler.enabled=true
```

kai (night-oncall): acknowledged. I'll escalate if p99 > 1s for >10min or if error rate >0.5%. Also will temporarily block noisy experimental endpoints if they appear.

maria (oncall): incident status: mitigated. Follow-ups: RUNTIME-1478 (per-tenant batch caps + safer autoscale), INFRA-2201 (autoscaler safe_cap). Postmortem scheduled. Jess will follow up with customers tomorrow AM.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0612 updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, mitigations=[batch_window=10ms, max_tokens_per_batch=8192, autoscaler_paused_canary, tenant_shaping=free_30r/s,growth_80r/s,feature_toggles=kernel_reuse,small_kernel_bundling,token_quant_hint].
